cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate is the position-2 primary cleanser and is supported by CAPB plus later betaine, glucoside and glucamide routes. Refatting ingredients buffer feel but do not make the net chassis merely ordinary.

formulaFacts.observation: primary anionic sulfate and main cleansing driver

cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Glyceryl oleate, glycol distearate, lecithin and cationic guar buffer the chassis enough to keep confidence moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: honey materials, glycerin, glyceryl oleate, glycol distearate, lecithin and cationic guar provide several rinse-off softness routes, but there is no silicone stack, protein system or rich 2-in-1 architecture.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The beeswax claim is not visible as a beeswax INCI entry, and the formula remains a sulfate-led rinse-off shampoo.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: multiple lipid/refatting and cationic guar routes can leave bounded residue, while the SLS-led system and absence of silicone or confirmed beeswax keep the band below high.
weightPotential.counterSignal: The formula has no silicone and no confirmed beeswax INCI; the primary SLS cleanser gives meaningful reset capacity.

unresolvedFacts: Exact lipid and polymer levels are not knowable from INCI order alone.
The beeswax marketing claim is preserved as a mismatch because no CERA ALBA / BEESWAX ingredient appears in the canonical INCI.
GTIN apply status remains an administrative hold and is not used in formula judgment.
weightAssessment.whyThisBand: Refatter, fatty ester, lecithin and cationic guar can plausibly reduce movement after repeated use.
weightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high because the formula lacks silicone, confirmed wax/butter payload and a low-reset chassis.

focusPrimary.rationale: Repair: revealed positioning is for stressed, damaged-looking hair, and the formula has compatible honey/humectant plus refatting/cationic care routes. Confidence stays moderate because the beeswax claim is not visible in INCI.

formulaFacts.observation: care clue compatible with damaged-looking hair positioning

focusPrimary.counterSignal: The product story names beeswax, but no beeswax INCI such as CERA ALBA is present; repair remains bounded.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: no distinct v1.4 secondary focus is supported; honey/beeswax positioning serves the same damaged-looking hair care story rather than an independent route.

formulaFacts.observation: care support but not a separate focus

focusSecondary.counterSignal: Humectant/refatting signals could later support a v1.5 moisture overlay, but moisture is not an allowed v1.4 focus.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are normal wet-hair massage and rinse-out use and there is no treatment or explicit reset trigger.

formulaFacts.observation: ordinary shampoo cleanser despite strong band

usageRole.counterSignal: The strong cleanser chassis would support alternating only if reset or oily-root positioning were revealed.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the packet is focused on stressed or damaged-looking hair, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp support.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Humectant/refatting ingredients may improve cosmetic feel, but v1.4 requires intentional scalp-comfort positioning for targeted.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete ordered formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

formulaFacts.observation: care/humectant clue, not a v1.4 dandruff active

dandruffSupport.counterSignal: No recognized v1.4 anti-dandruff active appears in the complete canonical INCI.

weightPotential.rationale: Both lanes selected moderate; residue is plausible but bounded by strong reset and no confirmed beeswax.

focusSecondary.rationale: Both lanes selected no secondary focus; no independent secondary route exists.
